{"proof":"  have h : i * (2 - Complex.I) = 1 + Complex.I := by
    calc
      i * (2 - Complex.I) = i * z := by rw [h₂]
      _ = v := h₀.symm
      _ = 1 + Complex.I := h₁
  have hI : Complex.I * Complex.I = -1 := Complex.I_mul_I
  field_simp
  linear_combination (2 + Complex.I) * h + i * hI"}
